regional.measure: Renter households in core housing need
regional.definition: Housing below cost, size or condition standards, with no affordable local alternative.
regional.coverage: Canadian Housing Survey, ten provinces; territories are outside this survey's coverage.
regional.source_period_note: Survey reference years are separate from the national saving-account periods.

trend.unit: Nominal CAD per household; full-year sums of quarterly estimates

cash.scope: Illustrative upfront cash only; prices and closing allowances are assumptions.
